description.zh: 先用复选框勾选多行数据，再对整个选择集一次性执行同一操作。选择时操作栏浮现，给出已选计数与撤销入口。它把重复的单条点击合并为一次批量决策，适合清理、归档、打标、导出等列表维护场景。
description.en: Tick many rows with checkboxes, then run one command against the whole selection at once. An action bar surfaces on selection with a count and an undo affordance. It collapses repetitive single-row clicks into one batch decision — ideal for list maintenance such as cleanup, archive, tagging and export.

use_when.zh: 同一操作要施加在大量行上（删除、归档、改状态）
use_when.en: One action must hit many rows — delete, archive, status change

use_when.zh: 列表是数据维护主界面（后台、收件箱、素材库）
use_when.en: Lists are the maintenance surface — admin, inbox, asset library

use_when.zh: 误操作成本可控，且能提供撤销
use_when.en: Mistakes are recoverable and undo can be offered

avoid_when.zh: 一行只有零星操作，逐条点并不费力
avoid_when.en: Sparse per-row work — one-by-one clicking is fine

avoid_when.zh: 操作不可逆且无审计/撤销，批量放大风险
avoid_when.en: Irreversible actions with no audit or undo — batching amplifies risk

avoid_when.zh: 移动端窄屏塞不下操作栏，勾选易误触
avoid_when.en: Narrow mobile screens where checkboxes misfire and bars crowd

note.zh: 有选中时底部或顶部浮现操作栏，最常见
note.en: A bar appears on selection at the bottom or top — the default

note.zh: 表头全选三态，支持反选缩小选择集
note.en: Tri-state header select-all with invert to narrow the set

note.zh: 操作栏固定在视口底部，滚动时始终可见
note.en: Bar pinned to the viewport bottom, always reachable while scrolling

notes.zh: 选择集存于 Set 或 id 数组；表头复选框用 indeterminate 表达半选。操作栏在计数大于 0 时 入场（translateY + opacity，时长乘 var(--demo-speed, 1)）。执行后用 toast 提示并提供撤销， 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。批量接口需服务端幂等，避免重复提交。
notes.en: Keep the selection as a Set or id array; the header checkbox uses indeterminate for partial selection. Slide the action bar in (translateY + opacity, durations scaled by var(--demo-speed, 1)) when the count exceeds zero. After running, show a toast with undo and respect prefers-reduced-motion. Bulk endpoints must be idempotent to survive double-submits.

basic.zh: 创建一个批量操作（Bulk Actions）演示：勾选多行后一次性删除或归档。
basic.en: Create a bulk-actions demo: select many rows, then delete or archive them in one go.

design.zh: 创建批量操作演示。要求：数据表首列复选框、表头全选三态；有选中时底部浮现操作栏显示"N 项已选"；提供归档、删除与清空选择；执行后 toast 提示并可撤销；支持深浅色主题。
design.en: Create a bulk-actions demo. Requirements: a checkbox column with a tri-state header select-all; a bottom action bar reading "N selected" when anything is ticked; Archive, Delete and Clear; a toast with undo after execution; light and dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + useState 维护 Set<string> 选中集；表头 checkbox 设 indeterminate；操作栏 条件渲染并做入场过渡（时长乘 var(--demo-speed, 1)）。删除先乐观移除、toast 提供撤销回滚。 role="row" / aria-selected 表达行选择状态。尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
implementation.en: Keep a Set<string> of selected ids in React state; set indeterminate on the header checkbox; conditionally render the action bar with an enter transition (durations scaled by var(--demo-speed, 1)). Delete optimistically and offer undo in the toast. Express row selection with role="row" / aria-selected. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现表格批量操作。

先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
要求：
- 复选框列 + 表头全选三态
- 有选中时浮现操作栏，显示已选计数
- 批量执行后提供撤销入口
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement table bulk actions in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse existing components.
Keep the project's visual style. Add no unnecessary dependencies.
Requirements:
- Checkbox column with a tri-state header select-all
- Action bar appears on selection with a live count
- Offer undo after a bulk operation
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.
